dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Baulette is a sweet dumpling. She is a little bit overweight and we are working on getting her fit. It seems that she hasn't been walked by her previous owner and was lost at first when I would take her for a walk. Now, with our predictable routine and slowly extended walks she picks up speed and seems to enjoy the scenery and new smells. She likes to pick her own route. Baulette loves to eat and highly food motivated, hence her excessive pounds. Second to food will be scratches, pets and any type of attention. She approaches when you sit down and puts her paws and head on your lap expecting scrathes and pets. Baulette is very good with kids and currently residing with a seven years old child. She could be jumpy at times but listens and responds to "down" command. She is slowly decompressing and played with a stick for the first time on our walk. Other than that she showed. no interest in toys.
Baulette is a perfect adult dog with low energy level, non destructive and shows no resource guarding. She doesn't need a busy schedule or extensive physical activity. She will be happy with a few walks and being around her humans during the day. She is crate trained and only occasionally vocal when she hears suspicious sounds.
We are still learning about her personality, but as of now she would be best in a household with no other animals and slow predictable schedule.

Meet Baulette!

Baulette came to ACC when her owner could no longer care for her, and now this sweet girl is looking for a fresh start. She may be a little low key, but she has a lot of love to give and enjoys taking in her surroundings at her own pace. Baulette is a gentle pup who is ready to find a family that will appreciate her calm personality and help her continue building confidence.

My Ideal Home

Baulette would thrive with an adopter who enjoys a more relaxed companion and can provide daily walks, enrichment, and positive reinforcement training. She is a low energy girl who does not need a packed schedule, just a loving home where she can feel comfortable and cared for. With patience and encouragement, Baulette is ready to be your new best friend.

Good with Other Pets?

Baulette has shown some feelings when seeing other dogs while on leash. She may stare, fixate, or pull toward them, but she is easily redirected with guidance. Continued positive reinforcement training and slow introductions will help Baulette feel more comfortable around canine friends.

Good with Kids?

Baulette has been comfortable with handling and enjoys gentle interactions. As with any dog, respectful introductions and supervision are recommended to help her feel successful in her new home.

Things to Know

Baulette is a sweet, easygoing older lady who enjoys sniffing around, taking treats, and spending time with her people. She may have a little bark when she sees another dog, but she's learning that she doesn't have to be the neighborhood announcer. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Baulette is ready to find a home where she can relax, unwind, and be the belle of the ball!

My Boroughbreaker writes: From my boroughbreak with her, she was low‑key, cuddly, friendly, and showed no resource guarding at all (she won't even steal treats mistakenly placed right beside her). She pulled on the leash only for the first block out of excitement, but because she's obese she can only walk short distances - about 5-10 minutes - before needing a break. She walks nicely beside or slitely ahead of the handler with no pulling.
Baulette had only minor leash reactivity, and both times it was easy to redirect. In a dog‑packed Central Park she actually lost interest in other dogs and stopped paying attention to any passerby dogs. She wasn't interested in birds or squirrels either.

A Volunteer Wrote: This little dumpling has charmed the volunteer and staff with her ever-cheerful spirit, waddling (and she does indeed waddle) along for waggy-tailed walks and showering us with affection! Baulette, who has lived with a child, is cuddly, playful and sweet and so ready to be loved again by a family.
dog.name: Baulette
